privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy states: 'We partner with OpenAI, the creators of GPT-4o mini, to offer you enhanced API development and testing capabilities' and 'In doing so, we may share the user-generated information you include in your prompts and APIs to generate content and provide enhanced AI capabilities.' OpenAI may then use that data per its own privacy policy. No opt-out mechanism documented.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: AES-256-GCM with X25519 key exchange for Agent communication; standard HTTPS for web platform

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Self-hosted deployments rely on customer database encryption. Cloud offering does not publicly specify.

security.name: Script Sandboxing
security.value: Pre- and post-request scripts run in QuickJS WebAssembly sandbox, isolated from browser context

security.name: Data Integrity
security.value: Ed25519 signatures and per-file BLAKE3 integrity hashes for verifying remote bundles

security.name: Rate Limiting & DDoS Protection
security.value: Request rate limiting and query complexity limits on GraphQL API for self-hosted deployments

security.name: Data Residency Control
security.value: Full control via self-hosted Community/Enterprise Edition; Cloud Edition location unspecified

products.name: Hoppscotch Cloud
products.data_scope: Hosted by vendor; data processing location unspecified
products.notes: Commercial cloud offering with unlimited collections and all features. Data shared with OpenAI for AI-enhanced capabilities. No explicit regional guarantees.

products.name: Hoppscotch Enterprise Edition
products.notes: Commercial self-hosted offering with SAML/OIDC SSO, audit logs, and on-premise deployment. Customer responsible for database encryption and backup security. Requires commercial license.

products.name: Hoppscotch Community Edition
products.notes: Free, open-source edition (MIT License). Can be used for personal and commercial projects. Can be self-hosted for full data control.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Community (free, open-source) + Cloud (commercial SaaS) + Enterprise (commercial self-hosted license)
compare.data_residency: Full control with self-hosted Community/Enterprise editions; Cloud edition location unspecified
